firm_data.firm_description: Haworth Barber & Gerstman, LLC is a boutique trial and litigation law firm. We service national and international manufacturers, retailers and the telecom industry as well as numerous insurance carriers and third-party administrators at both the primary and excess levels.

email.subject: AI for Haworth Barber & Gerstman, built for trial firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Tracy,

Your firm handles complex product liability and construction litigation for national manufacturers and insurance carriers across the country. That combination of high-stakes work and demanding clients is exactly why we built Lucio.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on discovery, document review, and litigation prep.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
